thesis: This episode argues that if H1B visas are priced, large tech companies like Amazon and Google will capture the vast majority of talent, leaving startups behind. It also suggests that consultancies would be squeezed by visa pricing, while companies like Oracle and Broadcom are making significant moves that the market has missed.
